meta.title: Markdown preview
meta.description: Renders your own messages as Markdown, in the draft and in the transcript. While you type, the input box itself grows an upper section that shows the message as it will read — lists, numbering, bold, quotes, tables and code blocks instead of raw markers; after sending, your messages show the same way in the conversation. Pasting a code chunk wraps it in a fenced block and names the language when it can tell. The card appears only once the draft contains Markdown syntax, and the MD button in the composer tool row is the master switch. Parsing happens in the browser only: the model still receives the original Markdown and the session log is unchanged.
